$meta.comment: Canonical Figma <-> code mapping (ADR-0010): component name -> code path -> Figma node-id, lookup only. Human-readable view: Architecture.md §3.1. Every entry's code file must carry `// figma: node-id=<nodeId>` in its header. Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time. Per-component design notes (discrepancies, token gaps, ticket history) live one file per component in design/notes/<ComponentFile>.md — see design/notes/README.md.
$meta.status: Phase 2 complete: every entry has a real nodeId and a built component

molecules_composed.$comment: Not a distinct Figma component (no separate componentId) -- a specific Atom/Input-field (3705:4402) instance reused inside a page frame. nodeId points at that instance, per component/README's 'fetched node' convention.

pages.$comment: Page-level Figma frames (#219). nodeId is the Breakpoints SECTION, which holds that page's Mobile and Desktop frames side by side -- that is the stable anchor to fetch from. The individual Mobile/Desktop container node-ids and the token binding measured on each live in design/notes/<Component>.md, not here, so this file stays a lookup. Two page frames are ALREADY mapped under organisms above and deliberately get no second entry: 'Te doen/Desktop/Filled' (3680:1442) = BoardView, 'Te doen/Mobile/AddItem' (3779:4846) = SidePanel -- some page frames simply are an organism.
